responsibility: Coordinates the coherence phase for `rustc_hir_analysis` by wiring coherence queries into the provider table and driving per-trait impl validation. It triggers specialization-graph overlap checking, enforces restrictions on explicitly implementable and marker traits, checks overlap with automatic `dyn Trait` impls, and delegates orphan, unsafety, built-in-trait, and inherent-impl coherence checks to the sibling modules.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is the crate-level trait-impl coherence driver: it registers coherence-related providers and walks impls to enforce overlap/orphan-style restrictions, marker-trait emptiness, manual-impl bans for certain lang traits, and `dyn Trait` auto-impl overlap, rather than performing body checking or type-lowering/inference.
